items.title: Ellen Rowe interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 2, 2024
items.q: of course Dave studied with Rayburn Wright as well so we’re all cut from the same cloth

ctx.x: Then he would Finale it afterwards.

Yeah, this again is another subject I’m passionate about and I’ll talk for hours — I’ll promise not to but I could. Yeah. I find, I can tell a difference between a student who has entered some big band score just on their computer, and a student who has taken the time to really sit down and try voicings and things out at the piano and done it by hand. Yeah it’s so important for me to think about the players who are playing the parts as I’m you know putting them out, and I’m really trying to think linearly — I’m…
Have you ever written a chart that did not have any improvised solos in it?
